items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: then John Hammond came up with this idea of getting this theater down on 12th Street someplace

ctx.x: When Fletcher's -- well, this is the only time, when we left Connie's Inn, and we were, you know, sort of knocking around, and then John Hammond came up with this idea of getting this theater down on 12th Street someplace, and he opened this theater, and then he had -- well, I guess on the surface it was a good idea. Fletcher, you know, advertised, 'Opening in this theater,' and of course he was very disliked by the men in Fletcher's band, and the men in Fletcher's band were very outspoken, very independent.
